description: This file defines the WorkActivityStore class, which manages and tracks activities related to jobs and tools within an application. It handles session management, activity state updates, icon state derivation, and integrates with external protocols for tool argument handling.

classes.name: WorkActivityStore
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for managing ongoing activities, including jobs and tools, within the application. It maintains current activity state, handles session updates, and computes icon states for UI presentation.

classes.name: WorkActivityStore.Activity
classes.description: A struct representing an activity (job or tool) with session key, role, kind, label, start time, and last update timestamp.

methods.name: handleJob
methods.description: Updates activity state based on job session key and its start or end status.

methods.name: handleTool
methods.description: Updates activity state based on tool session, phase, name, meta, and arguments.

methods.name: resolveIconState
methods.description: Determines and sets the current icon state based on an override selection.

methods.name: setMainSessionKey
methods.description: Sets and updates the main session key used to prioritize activities.
